title: Second part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system for the first part, setting the Euler angles to zero and the translation vector to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop consisting of eight curves. Start by drawing an arc from the point (0.0, 0.0035) to (0.0035, 0.0) with a midpoint at (0.001, 0.001). Next, draw a line from (0.0035, 0.0) to (0.0254, 0.0), followed by an arc from (0.0254, 0.0) to (0.0288, 0.0035) with a midpoint at (0.0278, 0.001). Continue with a line from (0.0288, 0.0035) to (0.0288, 0.0254), then an arc from (0.0288, 0.0254) to (0.0254, 0.0288) with a midpoint at (0.0278, 0.0278). Draw a line from (0.0254, 0.0288) to (0.0035, 0.0288), followed by an arc from (0.0035, 0.0288) to (0.0, 0.0254) with a midpoint at (0.001, 0.0278). Finally, draw a line from (0.0, 0.0254) to (0.0, 0.0035). For the second loop, draw four lines: from (0.0023, 0.0023) to (0.0265, 0.0023), from (0.0265, 0.0023) to (0.0265, 0.0265), from (0.0265, 0.0265) to (0.0023, 0.0265), and from (0.0023, 0.0265) back to (0.0023, 0.0023). Apply a scale factor of 0.0288 to the sketch. Rotate the sketch using Euler angles of zero and translate it using a vector of zero. Extrude the sketch 0.784 units in the direction of the normal and 0.0 units in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. The dimensions of the first part are: length 0.0288239815526518, width 0.0288239815526518, and height 0.784012298232129.

For the second part, create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to -90.0, 0.0, -90.0 and a translation vector of 0.0144, 0.0, 0.0. In the first face, draw the first loop consisting of three lines: from (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0288, 0.0), from (0.0288, 0.0) to (0.0288, 0.0288), and from (0.0288, 0.0288) back to (0.0, 0.0). In the second face, draw the first loop consisting of four lines: from (0.0, 0.75) to (0.0288, 0.7212), from (0.0288, 0.7212) to (0.0288, 0.784), from (0.0288, 0.784) to (0.0, 0.784), and from (0.0, 0.784) back to (0.0, 0.75). Apply a scale factor of 0.784 to the sketch. Rotate the sketch using Euler angles of -90.0, 0.0, -90.0 and translate it using a vector of 0.0144, 0.0, 0.0. Extrude the sketch 0.0072 units in both directions of the normal to cut the material from the existing body. The dimensions of the second part are: length 0.0288239815526518, width 0.7840122982321291, and height 0.0144119907763259.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the first part (cylinder with a rectangular section at the top and a smaller rectangular section at the bottom)
r = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0.0035).threePointArc((0.001, 0.001), (0.0035, 0.0)).lineTo(0.0254, 0).threePointArc((0.0278, 0.001), (0.0288, 0.0035)).lineTo(0.0288, 0.0254).threePointArc((0.0278, 0.0278), (0.0254, 0.0288)).lineTo(0.0035, 0.0288).threePointArc((0.001, 0.0278), (0.0, 0.0254)).close().moveTo(0.0023, 0.0023).lineTo(0.0265, 0.0023).lineTo(0.0265, 0.0265).lineTo(0.0023, 0.0265).close().extrude(0.784)

# Create the second part (cut the cylinder with a smaller rectangular section)
cut = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0288, 0).lineTo(0.0288, 0.0288).close().moveTo(0, 0.75).lineTo(0.0288, 0.7212).lineTo(0.0288, 0.784).lineTo(0, 0.784).close().extrude(0.0072, both=True)

# Apply the cut operation
r = r.cut(cut)

# Final model
r  # This will be the final model with the cut applied

sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0254, 0.0).threePointArc((0.0277, 0.001), (0.0288, 0.0034))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0288, 0.0254).threePointArc((0.0277, 0.0277), (0.0254, 0.0288))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0034, 0.0288).threePointArc((0.001, 0.0277), (0.0, 0.0254))
sketch = sketch.close()

# Create the inner loop
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0019, 0.0034).threePointArc((0.0023, 0.0023), (0.0034, 0.0019))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0254, 0.0019).threePointArc((0.0265, 0.0023), (0.0269, 0.0034))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0269, 0.0254).threePointArc((0.0265, 0.0265), (0.0254, 0.0269))
